intro: 「你今天維他命了嗎」是一款為日常補充習慣設計的健康記錄 App。首頁集中顯示今天的方案、提醒與完成率，把維他命方案、每日打卡、週月統計與常見營養知識整理在同一個地方，讓每天的保養更清楚、更容易持續。
建立方案後，服用時一鍵打卡；提醒可依早餐後、午餐後、晚餐後或睡前安排，收到通知時直接標記已服用，或延後 15 分鐘。日曆會留下每天的完成情況，連續打卡與每週、每月完成率讓你一眼看出哪些日子漏了。App 也整理了 47 種營養知識，並能依年齡、BMI、慢性病與用藥資訊給出一般性的提醒。
資料保留在裝置與 App Group 儲存空間，核心功能不需要登入或網路連線，並提供本機 JSON 備份與還原。App 提供的是一般營養教育與日常記錄，不是診斷、治療或個人醫療建議，也不取代醫師、藥師或營養師的專業意見。
features: 每日方案
建立維他命與補充品清單，首頁一眼看到今天的進度。
一鍵打卡
快速記錄今天是否已服用，也能從通知直接標記或延後 15 分鐘。
四個提醒時段
早餐後、午餐後、晚餐後或睡前；開啟前會先說明用途，由你決定。
日曆與完成率
日曆檢視每天的完成情況，並查看連續打卡、每週與每月完成率。
47 種營養知識
維他命、礦物質、草本與機能補充品的功效、來源與注意事項。
個人化參考
依年齡、性別、BMI、慢性病與用藥資訊整理一般性的提醒；身體資料都可以略過。
stepDetails: 第一次開啟時，引導會先說明提醒的用途，再由你決定是否開啟並選擇每日提醒時間；性別、年齡、身高與體重可以填，也可以略過。接著把正在使用的補充品逐項加入每日方案，為每一項選擇早餐後、午餐後、晚餐後或睡前。
首頁會顯示今天完成了幾項與連續打卡天數。服用後一鍵打卡；收到提醒時，也可以直接在通知上標記已服用，或延後 15 分鐘再提醒，不必特地打開 App。
在服用歷史的日曆查看每天的完成比例，再看最近的紀錄與每週、每月完成率，找出漏記的日子；連續打卡天數也是持續下去的小小動力。
more: 營養知識
依維他命、礦物質、草本與機能等分類瀏覽或搜尋 47 種營養知識；內容參考美國國家衛生研究院（NIH）膳食補充品辦公室等公開資料。
我的設定
填寫性別、年齡、身高、體重、健康目標，以及慢性病或用藥資訊，首頁的今日建議會依這些條件與方案劑量給出一般性的提醒。
桌面小工具
支援 iPhone 與 iPad 的主畫面小工具。
備份與還原
匯出 JSON 備份檔，換機後再還原；還原前 App 會先驗證檔案，避免無效檔案覆蓋現有資料。
語言
支援繁體中文、簡體中文、英文、日文、西班牙文、法文與義大利文。
tips: 把提醒設在固定會做的事情之後（例如早餐後），比設定一個時間更容易記得。
每週看一次完成率，比每天盯著數字更容易維持習慣。
App 提供的是一般營養資訊；若有慢性病、懷孕、正在用藥或需要高劑量補充，請先與醫師、藥師或營養師確認。
換手機前先匯出 JSON 備份，方案與紀錄才能一起帶走。

intro: Vitamin Today is a health log built around daily supplement habits. The home screen gathers today's plan, reminders and completion rate, and the app keeps your vitamin plan, daily check-ins, weekly and monthly statistics and general nutrition knowledge in one place, so the routine is clearer and easier to keep up.

Once a plan is set, logging a dose is a single tap. Reminders can be timed after breakfast, lunch or dinner or before bed, and a notification can be marked as taken or snoozed for 15 minutes on the spot. The calendar records each day, and your streak and weekly and monthly completion rates show at a glance which days were missed. The app also covers 47 nutrition topics and can offer general reminders based on age, BMI, chronic conditions and medication.

Data stays on the device and in App Group storage; the core features need no sign-in or internet connection, and a local JSON backup and restore is included. The app offers general nutrition education and record keeping, not diagnosis, treatment or personal medical advice, and it does not replace a doctor, pharmacist or dietitian.
features: Daily plan
Build a list of vitamins and supplements and see today's progress on the home screen.
One-tap check-in
Record today's dose quickly, or mark it as taken or snooze for 15 minutes straight from the notification.
Four reminder slots
After breakfast, lunch or dinner, or before bed; the app explains what reminders do before you choose to turn them on.
Calendar and completion rates
A calendar of each day's completion, plus your streak and weekly and monthly rates.
47 nutrition topics
What vitamins, minerals, herbal and functional supplements do, where they come from and what to watch for.
Personal reference
General reminders based on age, sex, BMI, chronic conditions and medication; every body detail is optional.
stepDetails: On first launch the setup explains what reminders are for and lets you decide whether to turn them on and choose a daily time; sex, age, height and weight can be filled in or skipped. Then add each supplement you already take to the daily plan and choose a slot for it: after breakfast, lunch or dinner, or before bed.

The home screen shows how many doses you have completed today and your current streak. After taking one, check it off with a tap; when a reminder arrives you can mark the dose as taken or snooze it for 15 minutes right from the notification, without opening the app.

Open the calendar in your intake history to see each day's completion, then look at recent records and the weekly and monthly rates to catch days you may have missed; your streak is a small nudge to keep going.
more: Nutrition knowledge
Browse or search 47 topics by category — vitamins, minerals, herbal and functional supplements — drawing on public sources such as the NIH Office of Dietary Supplements.
My settings
Enter sex, age, height, weight, health goals and any chronic conditions or medication, and the home screen's daily suggestions give general reminders based on them and your plan's doses.
Home-screen widgets
Widgets are available for iPhone and iPad.
Backup and restore
Export a JSON backup and restore it on a new phone; the app validates the file first so an invalid one never overwrites your data.
Languages
Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese, English, Japanese, Spanish, French and Italian.
tips: Anchor reminders to something you already do, such as after breakfast; it is easier to remember than a clock time.
Check the completion rate once a week rather than watching the numbers daily; habits hold better that way.
The app provides general nutrition information only. If you have a chronic condition, are pregnant, take medication or need high doses, check with a doctor, pharmacist or dietitian first.
Export a JSON backup before changing phones so your plan and records travel with you.
